diagnostic_cache_policy: Only external quadrature diagnostics are reused for exactly identical bytes, shapes, layouts, geometry, material/source identity, executed basis and quadrature. Every timed run freshly constructs all operators, factors, hierarchies and responses. Original rows, coefficient agreement and BLAS1/2 reconstruction are rechecked after every stopped timer. Any changed fingerprint receives fresh physical diagnostics.

classical_accuracy_and_archives.operator: the literal notebook permeability, source and Q1 quadrilateral forms
classical_accuracy_and_archives.boundary: homogeneous pressure on all exterior sides; no pressure gauge

approximation_spaces.CG: globally continuous nodal Q1 on the full fine Cartesian mesh
approximation_spaces.MHM: local Q1 with weak continuity through the declared continuous P1 macroface trace space

cg_lu.basis: declared Q1 nodal reference functions and archived mesh connectivity

cg_amg.basis: declared Q1 nodal reference functions and archived mesh connectivity

classical_accuracy_and_archives.indicator_scope: A descriptive comparison of measured pressure/flux errors, not a stability theorem or an acquisition gate. Ratios outside the interval remain reported; unequal accuracy qualifies timing comparisons.
